claims.claim: content replicates: one chain head + one length across all nodes, every archive verifies, and a post submitted on one node is searchable from another over real sockets
the emergent mesh feed works: a minority user's feed is dominated by their own community's authors (local clustering over real homes)
a fresh sockpuppet (standing below the gate) contributes nothing to a removal
a spam post flagged by 3 standing users is removed through the 9-guardian 2/3 quorum
a fabricated brigade on a good post is REJECTED by the quorum (guardians trust earned standing), where a central 3-flag rule would have removed it
the archive is tamper-evident: a flipped payload breaks verify() at its sequence while the other nodes stay valid
the network survives node death: content is served by survivors and a stateless restart resyncs to a bit-identical, verifying archive

verdict: SUPPORTED (structural, over real TCP processes): the bazaar works as a network - posts replicate to a single verifying archive across all nodes, the emergent mesh feed routes minority users to their own community, removal is standing-gated and quorum-confirmed (sockpuppets contribute nothing, fabricated brigades are rejected where a central rule would remove), the archive is tamper-evident, and a crashed node's content is served by survivors while a stateless restart resyncs to a bit-identical chain - on the repo's own T70 socket transport, LedgerChain archive, and DecentralNet feed routing, with mutual TLS optional
